```python
import re
from pathlib import Path

WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[^\W\d_]+")
SENTENCE_END_RE = re.compile(r"[.!?]+")


def main():
    text = (Path("дані") / "текст.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    sentences = []
    for segment in SENTENCE_END_RE.split(text):
        words = WORD_RE.findall(segment)
        if words:
            sentences.append(words)

    ranked = sorted(
        enumerate(sentences, start=1),
        key=lambda item: (-len(item[1]), item[0]),
    )

    for k, words in ranked[:3]:
        print(f"№{k} ({len(words)} слів): {' '.join(words[:3])}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
